dish.title: Burmese Mohinga: Catfish and Lemongrass Noodle Soup

recipe_version.title: Burmese Mohinga: Catfish and Lemongrass Noodle Soup
recipe_version.description: Myanmar's national breakfast, perfect for dinner: a turmeric-gold catfish broth fragrant with lemongrass, ginger, and garlic, thickened with toasted chickpea flour and ground rice, poured over thin rice noodles and finished with boiled egg, lime, cilantro, and chile.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for poaching the fish and the broth

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.preparation: 2 bruised and cut into lengths, 1 tender core minced

ingredients.name: jasmine rice
ingredients.note: toasted and ground for the broth

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Bruise 2 lemongrass stalks with the back of a knife and cut into 3-inch lengths; mince the tender core of the third. Slice 1 inch of ginger; chop the other inch. Blend the minced lemongrass, chopped ginger, garlic, shallots, turmeric, and paprika into a coarse paste. Toast the 2 tbsp rice in a dry skillet until golden, grind it fine, and toast the chickpea flour in the same skillet, stirring, until fragrant, 3 minutes. Whisk both into 1 cup cold water until smooth.

steps.title: Poach the fish
steps.body: Bring 8 cups water, the lemongrass lengths, sliced ginger, and 1 tsp salt to a simmer in the soup pot. Add the catfish and poach gently until it flakes, 8 to 10 minutes. Lift out the fish and flake it; strain and keep the broth.

steps.title: Cook the paste
steps.body: Rinse and dry the pot. Heat the oil over medium and cook the aromatic paste, stirring, until it darkens and smells sweet, 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in half the flaked fish and mash it into the paste.

steps.title: Thicken the broth
steps.body: Pour in the strained broth, bring to a simmer, and whisk in the flour slurry (the toasted flours in their 1 cup water). Simmer on medium-low, stirring often, 15 minutes, until lightly thickened and silky. Add the fish sauce and the remaining flaked fish.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.body: During the broth simmer, lower the eggs into 6 cups boiling water in the 2-quart saucepan, boil 10 minutes, cool under running tap, peel, and halve. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: Also during the simmer, cook the noodles in 16 cups (4 quarts) boiling water in the 6- to 8-quart pot until tender, 3 to 4 minutes, and drain. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Divide the noodles among deep bowls, ladle the hot broth and fish over them, and top with egg halves, cilantro, chile flakes, and lime wedges.

equipment: second 6- to 8-quart pot for the noodles
